# Topic 25 external audit — colchicine in secondary cardiovascular prevention

Audit date: 2026-10-10. Repository: mahmood726-cyber/meta-harness.
Reference examined: `0730234d0b4f`.
Recorded review SHA-256: `fc15d28ea1f6f27fad2506e818a6d96a6a097ea5a822fc3e40fc0a0b4e3be0b6`.
Recorded status: ABANDONED_BY_DECISION. This audit does not reinstate the topic.

## Re-run these checks

Use Python 3.10 or later; no third-party packages are required.

```sh
python audit.py
```

This writes `results.json` and reports 20 passing computational/fixture checks.
Passing fixture checks include reproductions of faulty endpoint matches: they are
NOT validations that those matches are clinically correct.

## What was actually executed

* Independent log-HR inverse-variance pooling with Paule–Mandel tau-squared,
  floored HKSJ uncertainty and the declared t_(k-1) prediction-interval convention.
* Three SHA-256 calculations on manually transcribed, displayed passage strings.
* Eight isolated endpoint-matcher cases, plus a component-parser check, using
  manually transcribed functions from the pinned `harness/rob2.py`.
* Seeded screening sampling from a manually transcribed 120-row ID order.
* Leave-one-out calculations (diagnostic only: two trials remain in each).

## Explicit limits

This is NOT a repository clone, canonical certificate verifier, build replay,
production screening execution, full D5 assessment or G1 test. The original
full Python module was not acquired as a local byte-identical file. The excerpt
was manually transcribed; its local SHA is not the original module's blob ID.

The pinned page and certificate agree on the recorded review identity. The
canonical review/HTML hashes were not regenerated. A direct live-page request
failed (502), and local network acquisition failed (proxy name resolution).
No statement is made about today's deployed bytes.

The primary trial inputs were checked against their original PubMed abstracts.
Risk-of-bias input objects and relevant source functions were inspected through
the GitHub connector. All clinical tables in the report are our own transcriptions
or calculations; no publisher PDFs or full trial articles are redistributed.
No visual PDF inspection is claimed or needed for the HTML/abstract checks here.

Some ClinicalTrials.gov URLs returned only application shells. DRC-04 design was
independently checked against its matching original UMIN registration. Complete
live registry JSON was not recovered for the sample's COLCHICINE-PROTECT/COLPET
records, so their decisions are not independently signed off.

No repository, website, trial record, email or G1 status was modified.
